title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units (Sennrich, Haddow, Birch)
key_points: This is the original paper introducing BPE-based subword segmentation for NMT (arXiv 1508.07909, v5).
It proposes encoding rare and unknown words as sequences of subword units to enable open-vocabulary translation, replacing back-off-to-dictionary approaches.
The segmentation is based on the byte pair encoding compression algorithm; the paper also compares it against simple character n-gram models.
Empirically, subword models improve over a back-off dictionary baseline by 1.1 BLEU (En-De) and 1.3 BLEU (En-Ru) on WMT 15 tasks.
raw_excerpt: we introduce a simpler and more effective approach, making the NMT model capable of open-vocabulary translation by encoding rare and unknown words as sequences of subword units... a segmentation based on the byte pair encoding compression algorithm, and empirically show that subword models improve over a back-off dictionary baseline for the WMT 15 translation tasks English-German and English-Russian by 1.1 and 1.3 BLEU, respectively.

title: google/sentencepiece — README
key_points: SentencePiece is a fast, lightweight, unsupervised text tokenizer/detokenizer for neural text generation where vocabulary size is fixed before training.
It implements subword units including Byte-Pair-Encoding (BPE) [Sennrich et al.] and the unigram language model [Kudo].
It trains directly from raw sentences, treating input as a raw sequence of Unicode characters, eliminating language-specific pre/post-processing.
It escapes whitespace with the meta-symbol ▁ (U+2581) and includes it in tokenization, making detokenization a lossless string-join operation independent of language.
It supports subword regularization and BPE-dropout (mentioned in the 'Why SentencePiece?' section).
raw_excerpt: It implements subword units —including Byte-Pair-Encoding (BPE) [Sennrich et al.] and the unigram language model [Kudo.]—with the ability to train directly from raw sentences. By treating input text as a raw sequence of Unicode characters, SentencePiece enables a purely end-to-end, language-independent pipeline... It escapes whitespaces with a meta-symbol ▁ (U+2581) and includes it in the tokenization. This design ensures that detokenization is a simple, lossless string join operation.

title: openai/tiktoken — README
key_points: tiktoken is described as a fast BPE tokeniser for use with OpenAI's models.
It provides encodings such as o200k_base and cl100k_base, and encoding_for_model() to get the tokeniser for a specific model (e.g., gpt-4o).
BPE is described as reversible/lossless, works on arbitrary text (even unseen text), compresses text (each token ~4 bytes on average), and lets the model see common subwords (e.g., 'ing').
tiktoken is claimed to be 3-6x faster than a comparable open-source tokeniser (measured on 1GB of text with the GPT-2 tokeniser).
It includes an educational submodule (tiktoken._educational) with code to train and visualise the BPE procedure.
raw_excerpt: tiktoken is a fast BPE tokeniser for use with OpenAI's models... Byte pair encoding (BPE) is a way of converting text into tokens. It has a couple desirable properties: It's reversible and lossless... It works on arbitrary text, even text that is not in the tokeniser's training data... It compresses the text... On average, in practice, each token corresponds to about 4 bytes.

title: Hugging Face Transformers Docs — Tokenization algorithms (Summary of the tokenizers)
key_points: Transformers supports three subword tokenization algorithms: Byte pair encoding (BPE), Unigram, and WordPiece.

BPE: a pre-tokenizer splits text into unique words with frequencies; a base vocabulary is built from all characters; BPE iteratively merges the most frequent adjacent pair until the target vocabulary size is reached.
BPE vocabulary size = base vocabulary size + number of merges (e.g., GPT uses 40,478 = 478 base tokens + 40,000 merges).
Any character not in the base vocabulary maps to an unknown token like <unk>; in practice the base vocabulary covers all characters seen during training.
raw_excerpt: Transformers support three subword tokenization algorithms: Byte pair encoding (BPE), Unigram, and WordPiece... BPE starts with individual characters and iteratively merges the most frequent adjacent pair... BPE continues learning merge rules until it reaches the target vocabulary size, which equals the base vocabulary size plus the number of merges. GPT uses BPE with a vocabulary size of 40,478 (478 base tokens + 40,000 merges).

title: Scaling Laws with Vocabulary: Larger Models Deserve Larger Vocabularies
key_points: 该论文研究词表大小如何影响 LLM 的 scaling law，训练了 33M 到 3B 参数、最多 500B 字符的模型，并配置不同词表大小。
论文提出三种互补方法预测 compute-optimal 词表大小：IsoFLOPs 分析、导数估计、损失函数的参数化拟合。
论文结论：最优词表大小取决于算力预算，更大的模型需要更大的词表。
论文指出多数 LLM 使用的词表偏小；预测 Llama2-70B 的最优词表至少应为 216K，是其实际 32K 词表的 7 倍。
论文用 3B 参数模型在不同 FLOPs 预算下做了实证验证：将词表从常规 32K 增至 43K，在相同 2.3e21 FLOPs 下 ARC-Challenge 分数从 29.1 提升到 32.0。
论文发表于 NeurIPS 2024，代码与 demo 位于 github.com/sail-sg/scaling-with-vocab 与 huggingface space sail/scaling-with-vocab-demo。
raw_excerpt: Our approaches converge on the conclusion that the optimal vocabulary size depends on the compute budget, with larger models requiring larger vocabularies. Most LLMs, however, use insufficient vocabulary sizes. For example, we predict that the optimal vocabulary size of Llama2-70B should have been at least 216K, 7 times larger than its vocabulary of 32K. ... By increasing the vocabulary size from the conventional 32K to 43K, we improve performance on ARC-Challenge from 29.1 to 32.0 with the same 2.3e21 FLOPs.

title: Subword Regularization: Improving Neural Network Translation Models with Multiple Subword Candidates (Kudo, ACL 2018)
key_points: 论文提出一种基于 unigram 语言模型的新子词切分算法（unigram language model based subword segmentation algorithm），用于更好的子词采样。
论文提出 subword regularization：训练时按概率对多种子词切分进行采样，以提升 NMT 鲁棒性。
论文作者为 Taku Kudo（Google Inc.），2018 年 4 月 29 日提交，被 ACL 2018 接收为长文。
论文指出同一句子在同一词表下可存在多种子词切分（segmentation ambiguity），BPE 只产生唯一子词序列。
raw_excerpt: In addition, for better subword sampling, we propose a new subword segmentation algorithm based on a unigram language model. ... We present a simple regularization method, subword regularization, which trains the model with multiple subword segmentations probabilistically sampled during training.

title: Subword Regularization (Kudo 2018) — HTML full text, Introduction
key_points: 论文将 Schuster and Nakajima (2012) 列为把罕见词拆分为子词单元的早期工作之一，与 Chitnis & DeNero (2015)、Sennrich et al. (2016)、Wu et al. (2016) 并列。
论文指出 BPE（Sennrich et al. 2016）是事实标准的子词切分算法，将句子编码为唯一子词序列。
论文以 'Hello World' 为例展示同一句子在同一词表下可对应多种子词序列（如 _Hell/o/_world、_H/ello/_world 等），说明切分存在虚假歧义（spurious ambiguity）。
论文主张训练时使用多种切分候选可让模型对噪声与切分错误更鲁棒，并间接学习词的组合性（如 books = book + s）。
raw_excerpt: A common approach for dealing with the open vocabulary issue is to break up rare words into subword units Schuster and Nakajima (2012); Chitnis and DeNero (2015); Sennrich et al. (2016); Wu et al. (2016). Byte-Pair-Encoding (BPE) Sennrich et al. (2016) is a de facto standard subword segmentation algorithm ... BPE encodes a sentence into a unique subword sequence.

title: Scaling Laws with Vocabulary: Larger Models Deserve Larger Vocabularies
key_points: 该研究训练了 33M 到 3B 参数规模的模型，训练数据最多 500B 字符，并配置了不同的词表大小，以考察词表大小如何影响 LLM 的缩放律。
论文提出三种互补方法来预测计算最优（compute-optimal）的词表大小：IsoFLOPs 分析、导数估计、以及损失函数的参数化拟合。
三种方法一致得出结论：最优词表大小取决于计算预算（compute budget），更大的模型需要更大的词表。
论文预测 Llama2-70B 的最优词表大小应至少为 216K，是其实际使用的 32K 词表的 7 倍。
论文用 3B 参数模型在不同 FLOPs 预算下训练，实证验证了预测结果。
在相同 2.3e21 FLOPs 预算下，将词表从常规的 32K 增大到 43K，ARC-Challenge 性能从 29.1 提升到 32.0。
论文结论强调：为高效预训练，需将 tokenization 与模型缩放联合考虑。
该论文发表于 NeurIPS 2024。
raw_excerpt: We investigate how vocabulary size impacts LLM scaling laws by training models ranging from 33M to 3B parameters on up to 500B characters with various vocabulary configurations. We propose three complementary approaches for predicting the compute-optimal vocabulary size: IsoFLOPs analysis, derivative estimation, and parametric fit of the loss function. Our approaches converge on the conclusion that the optimal vocabulary size depends on the compute budget, with larger models requiring larger vocabularies. ... we predict that the optimal vocabulary size of Llama2-70B should have been at least 216K, 7 times larger than its vocabulary of 32K. ... By increasing the vocabulary size from the conventional 32K to 43K, we improve performance on ARC-Challenge from 29.1 to 32.0 with the same 2.3e21 FLOPs.

title: Language Model Tokenizers Introduce Unfairness Between Languages
key_points: 同一段文本翻译成不同语言后，tokenization 长度差异巨大，某些情况下可达 15 倍（differences up to 15 times in some cases）。
即使是为多语言支持而专门训练的 tokenizer，这种 token 长度差异依然存在。
字符级（character-level）和字节级（byte-level）模型在某些语言对上仍表现出超过 4 倍的编码长度差异（over 4 times the difference in the encoding length）。
该差异导致部分语言社区在商业语言服务成本、处理时间与延迟、以及可作为上下文提供给模型的内容量方面受到不公平对待——即 token 数直接影响可提供的上下文内容量。
作者主张未来语言模型应使用多语言公平的子词 tokenizer（multilingually fair subword tokenizers）。
论文发表于 NeurIPS 2023。
raw_excerpt: The same text translated into different languages can have drastically different tokenization lengths, with differences up to 15 times in some cases. These disparities persist even for tokenizers that are intentionally trained for multilingual support. Character-level and byte-level models also exhibit over 4 times the difference in the encoding length for some language pairs. This induces unfair treatment for some language communities in regard to the cost of accessing commercial language services, the processing time and latency, as well as the amount of content that can be provided as context to the models.

缓存折扣：cache hit 约为 cache miss 的 1/50（flash $0.15→$0.003；pro $0.66→$0.022）。
输入/输出差异：output 约为 cache-miss input 的 4 倍（flash 0.15→0.6；pro 0.66→1.98）。
时段折扣：off-peak 价格为 peak 的 5 折；peak 时段为 UTC 周一至周五 01:00–04:00 与 06:00–10:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余时段（含周末及中国法定节假日）均为 off-peak。
上下文长度 1M，最大输出 384K；支持 thinking 与非 thinking 模式（默认 thinking）。
计费公式：expense = number of tokens × price；优先扣减 granted balance。
官方声明产品价格可能变动并保留调价权。

title: DeepSeek Token & Token Usage (official API docs)
key_points: token 是模型表示自然语言的基本单位，也是计费单位。
换算比：1 个英文字符 ≈ 0.3 token；1 个中文字符 ≈ 0.6 token。
官方说明不同模型 tokenization 方法不同，换算比会变化；实际 token 数以模型返回的 usage 为准。
提供离线 tokenizer 工具包（deepseek_tokenizer.zip）用于计算输入/输出 token 用量。

raw_excerpt: Tokens are the basic units used by models to represent natural language text, and also the units we use for billing. ... 1 English character ≈ 0.3 token. 1 Chinese character ≈ 0.6 token. However, due to the different tokenization methods used by different models, the conversion ratios can vary. The actual number of tokens processed each time is based on the model's return.

o200k_base 由 load_tiktoken_bpe 从 https://openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net/encodings/o200k_base.tiktoken 加载 mergeable_ranks，未设置 explicit_n_vocab 字段。

title: google/sentencepiece — README
key_points: SentencePiece 自我定位为 'a fast, lightweight, and unsupervised text tokenizer and detokenizer designed for neural network-based text generation systems (such as Large Language Models) where the vocabulary size is fixed prior to training'。
README 声明其实现 subword units，包括 Byte-Pair-Encoding (BPE) [Sennrich et al.] 与 unigram language model [Kudo.]，可直接从原始句子训练。
核心设计：将输入文本视为原始 Unicode 字符序列，用元符号 ▁ (U+2581) 转义空白并纳入分词，使 detokenization 成为无损的字符串拼接操作，与语言无关。
README 强调无需语言相关的预分词器（如 Moses、MeCab、KyTea），对中文、日文、泰文等无显式词边界的语言尤为有效。
README 明确声明 'This is not an official Google product.'。
仓库页面显示提交总数为 1,539 Commits（未显示 stars 数与最近提交日期）。

title: Byte Latent Transformer: Patches Scale Better Than Tokens
key_points: BLT 是一种字节级 LLM 架构，作者称其首次在规模上匹配基于分词的 LLM 性能，并在推理效率与鲁棒性上有显著改进。
BLT 将字节编码为动态大小的 patch（patches），patch 作为主要计算单元。
patch 的分段依据下一个字节的熵（entropy of the next byte），在数据复杂度高的地方分配更多计算与模型容量。
论文给出了首个字节级模型的 FLOP 受控扩展研究（FLOP controlled scaling study），规模达 8B 参数、4T 训练字节。
结论主张：在固定推理成本下，BLT 的扩展性显著优于基于分词的模型，可同时增大 patch 与模型规模。
论文报告在推理与长尾泛化（long tail generalization）上有定性改进。
raw_excerpt: We introduce the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT), a new byte-level LLM architecture that, for the first time, matches tokenization-based LLM performance at scale with significant improvements in inference efficiency and robustness. BLT encodes bytes into dynamically sized patches... Patches are segmented based on the entropy of the next byte... We present the first FLOP controlled scaling study of byte-level models up to 8B parameters and 4T training bytes.

title: facebookresearch/blt (Byte Latent Transformer)
key_points: 该仓库为论文 "Byte Latent Transformer: Patches Scale Better Than Tokens" 的官方代码库。
README 称 BLT 是字节级 LLM 架构，首次在规模上匹配基于分词的 LLM 性能，并在推理效率与鲁棒性上有显著改进。
README 描述 BLT 包含新的注意力机制以最大化字节与 patch 隐表示之间的信息流，以及一种新的字节序列记忆（byte-sequence memory）。
README 称其为首个可从字节端到端训练、无需分词或其他预处理的规模化模型（scaling study 至 8B 参数、8T 训练字节）。
已发布 BLT 1B 与 BLT 7B 的 HuggingFace 权重；作者称正与 HF 合作将 BLT 集成进 Transformers。
仓库处于活跃开发状态（65 commits），作者称正在持续更新代码以便复现结果。
raw_excerpt: This repository contains code for our paper: "Byte Latent Transformer: Patches Scale Better Than Tokens"... The BLT architecture includes new attention mechanisms to maximize the information flow between byte and patch hidden representations and a new type of byte-sequence memory. We present the first scaling study of byte-level models up to 8B parameters and 8T training bytes, showing for the first time that we can train a model end-to-end at scale from bytes with no tokenization or other preprocessing... We have released weights on HF for the BLT 1B Model and BLT 7B Model.
